+function SubjectSwitcher({ activeSubjects, onChange }) {
+  const [open, setOpen] = z.useState(false);
+  const subjects = [
+    { id: "math", name: "Toán", icon: "📐" },
+    { id: "physics", name: "Vật lí", icon: "⚛️" },
+    { id: "chemistry", name: "Hóa học", icon: "🧪" },
+    { id: "biology", name: "Sinh học", icon: "🧬" }
+  ];
+  const toggle = (id) => {
+    let next;
+    if (activeSubjects.includes(id)) {
+      if (activeSubjects.length <= 1) return;
+      next = activeSubjects.filter(s => s !== id);
+    } else {
+      next = [...activeSubjects, id];
+    }
+    onChange(next);
+  };
+  return f.jsx(Oo, {
+    open,
+    setOpen,
+    button: f.jsxs(Nt, {
+      title: "Chế độ Môn học: Chọn Toán, Lí, Hóa, Sinh",
+      onClick: () => setOpen(!open),
+      children: [
+        f.jsx("span", { style: { fontSize: "14px" }, children: "🔬" }),
+        f.jsx(fe.chevron, {})
+      ]
+    }),
+    children: f.jsxs("div", {
+      className: "subject-picker-pop",
+      style: { padding: "8px 12px", minWidth: "160px" },
+      children: [
+        f.jsx("div", { style: { fontWeight: "bold", fontSize: "12px", marginBottom: "8px", color: "var(--muted, #666)" }, children: "CHỌN MÔN DẠY" }),
+        subjects.map(s => f.jsxs("label", {
+          key: s.id,
+          style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", padding: "5px 0", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: "13px" },
+          children: [
+            f.jsx("input", {
+              type: "checkbox",
+              checked: activeSubjects.includes(s.id),
+              onChange: () => toggle(s.id)
+            }),
+            f.jsx("span", { children: s.icon }),
+            f.jsx("span", { style: { fontWeight: activeSubjects.includes(s.id) ? "bold" : "normal" }, children: s.name })
+          ]
+        }, s.id))
+      ]
+    })
+  });
